notes: Modified cash basis school district (FY ended 2025-08-31). Governmental funds from Exhibit III total column (pp5, 7); beginning/ending cash is the governmental funds total fund balance (all cash plus county treasurer balance). Bond proceeds 14,950,000 are in debt_proceeds; printed Total Receipts 21,287,403.10 includes them. Transfers 144,666.25 (General to Activities 70,000 and School Nutrition 74,666.25). Balance sheet from Exhibit I (government-wide, modified cash); county treasurers' balance categorized as cash and investments (cash held by county treasurers, Schedule N). No business-type funds (school nutrition is presented in governmental funds). Detail: General Fund disbursements use Schedule M (object detail by program, more detailed) and not Schedule B; Schedule M total 5,054,392.00 includes transfers 144,666.25 (shown as other financing, signed). General Fund receipts from Schedule A; blank-actual budget-only lines (3155, 4519, 1790, 2900-700, 3100-700, 2630 salaries/benefits/other items, 1200 other items, zero-amount lines 6990/6997/6998, Bond Fund 8000-911 transfer 0.00) omitted. Schedule N (county treasurer general fund) not recorded as detail to avoid double counting with Schedule A; Schedule B and Schedule N skipped. Schedule H (Bond Fund) and Schedule D disbursements print no total line so no detail_totals for those. Depreciation fund 5200 allocation from General Fund (725,000) is printed as a receipt, not a transfer, in Exhibit III; kept as receipt with review. Recheck: Local Receipts split by fund schedules (GF Schedule A, Special Building Schedule I, Activities Schedule F); Other Expenses and Services split by fund schedules (Special Building, Depreciation, Employee Benefit). Read pages 1-29 of 29. County Receipts split by Schedule A (2110 fines 27,799.97, 2210 ESU 2,059.72).

decision_needed.question: $725,000 'Allocation from General Fund' has no matching transfer out on any page. Is it a transfer, or revenue?

report_discrepancies.note: Depreciation Fund Schedule C (p15) and Exhibit III (p4) print 5200 'Allocation from General Fund' 725,000.00 as a Non-Revenue Receipt, but the General Fund (Exhibit III p6, Schedule M) shows only 144,666.25 of transfers out and no 725,000 outflow; the interfund allocation is one-sided. Kept as printed (receipt); see decision_needed.
